description: Check what happened to a link from create_upload_link. Use it after the user says they dropped the file, or to see whether they have; for scenes from upload_scene use get_scene_status. Parameter: `link` takes the full link or just the 22-character token after /drop/; a link created by another account reads as unknown. Read-only and free to repeat; poll every 10 to 30 seconds while the state is uploading or building. When done, pass the returned `scene` to get_embed_code, create_share_link or set_camera_path; if expired, create a new link. Requires sign-in (connector sign-in, or VERSE_API_KEY for the local server).

link.description: The upload link from create_upload_link (or its token).
